import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Calculate Total Spending by summing relevant columns
df['Total_Spending'] = df[['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                           'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']].sum(axis=1)

# Create a scatter plot of Income vs Total Spending, colored by Marital Status
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Income', y='Total_Spending', hue='Marital_Status', palette='viridis', alpha=0.7)

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Income vs Total Spending by Marital Status', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Income', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Marital Status')
plt.grid(True)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
